/* ============================================================
   Voice Agent Platform — "White Paper" (PlayStation design system)
   Council-winning spec: Proposal A + amendments (B stats/CTA, C tokens)
   Canvas: white / soft / black / one blue band · Display: Roboto 300
   Chrome/body: Inter · Data: Inter tabular-nums · NO monospace
   ============================================================ */


:root{
  /* ---- light canvas (default) ---- */
  --bg:#ffffff; --bg-2:#f5f7fa; --bg-3:#f3f3f3;
  /* ---- brand (PlayStation blue is precious) ---- */
  --primary:#0070d1;            /* fills, borders, dots, CTA pills */
  --primary-pressed:#0064b7;
  --primary-active:#004d8d;
  --primary-ink:#0070d1;        /* blue TEXT/icons — flips per canvas */
  --accent:#0064b7;             /* secondary step (was violet) */
  --accent-2:#0064b7;
  --warm:#1f2024;               /* Robert = charcoal ink identity */
  --warm-2:#121314;
  --icon:#1f2024;               /* neutral icon chrome */
  /* ---- semantics (token-pure: blue=success, DS warning) ---- */
  --good:#0070d1; --warn:#c81b3a; --bad:#c81b3a;
  /* ---- ink ---- */
  --text:#121314; --muted:rgba(0,0,0,.6); --faint:#6b6b6b;
  /* ---- lines & depth (flat world — no shadows) ---- */
  --line:rgba(0,0,0,.08); --line-soft:rgba(0,0,0,.06);
  --grad:#0070d1;               /* SOLID blue — legacy gradient call sites degrade safely */
  --grad-gold:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffce21 0%,#f5a623 55%,#ee8e00 100%); /* ONE use deck-wide (S12) */
  --shadow-card:none; --shadow-pop:none;
  /* ---- typography ---- */
  --font-heading:'Roboto',sans-serif;
  --font-body:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --font-num:'Inter',sans-serif;
  --fs-display:54px; --fs-h1:44px; --fs-h2:28px; --fs-h3:22px;
  --fs-body:16px; --fs-small:14px; --fs-micro:12px;
}

*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{background:var(--bg)}

/* ---- canvas scoping (the band change IS the divider) ---- */
.slide--soft{--bg:#f3f3f3; --bg-2:#ffffff}
.slide--dark{--bg:#000000; --bg-2:#181818; --bg-3:#121314;
  --text:#ffffff; --muted:rgba(255,255,255,.7); --faint:#cccccc;
  --line:rgba(229,229,229,.2); --line-soft:rgba(229,229,229,.12);
  --primary-ink:#53b1ff; --icon:#cccccc; --good:#53b1ff; --accent-2:#53b1ff}
.slide--blue{--bg:#0070d1; --bg-2:rgba(255,255,255,.10); --bg-3:rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  --text:#ffffff; --muted:rgba(255,255,255,.85); --faint:#dbeafd;
  --line:rgba(255,255,255,.28); --line-soft:rgba(255,255,255,.16);
  --primary:#ffffff; --primary-ink:#ffffff; --icon:#ffffff; --accent:#ffffff; --accent-2:#ffffff; --grad:#ffffff}

::selection{background:rgba(0,112,209,.22);color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary-ink);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:4px}
button{font-family:inherit}
[hidden]{display:none!important}

/* ---- slide canvas: flat, band-colored, zero atmosphere ---- */
.slide{
  width:1280px;height:720px;overflow:hidden;overflow:clip;position:relative;
  background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);
  font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:var(--fs-body);line-height:1.5;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;
}

/* ---- legacy decor: retired (markup deleted in sweep; this is the net) ---- */
.orb{display:none!important}

/* ---- surfaces: 8px radius, hairline, lift = surface contrast ---- */
.card{background:var(--bg-2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px}
.card-lift{background:#ffffff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;box-shadow:none}
.slide--dark .card-lift{background:#181818;border-color:rgba(229,229,229,.2)}
.slide--soft .card-lift{background:#ffffff}
.slide--blue .card-lift{background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.28)}
.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:9999px;padding:5px 14px;color:var(--faint);background:transparent;
  font-size:12px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.1px}
.kicker{letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--faint);
  font-size:12px;font-weight:500;font-family:var(--font-body)}
/* emphasis = the single blue phrase; no gradient text, ever */
.grad-text{color:var(--primary-ink);background:none;-webkit-background-clip:initial;background-clip:initial;-webkit-text-fill-color:currentColor}
.grad-vio{color:var(--primary-ink)}
.num{font-family:var(--font-num);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.divider{height:1px;background:var(--line)}

/* ---- icon badge: neutral chrome — blue lives elsewhere ---- */
.ib{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:8px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;
  background:var(--bg-3);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.ib .material-icons{font-size:22px;color:var(--icon)}

/* ---- SVG avatars (Layla the agent · Robert the caller) — flat vector ---- */
.av{display:block}
.av .av-eye{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;animation:blink 4.8s ease-in-out infinite}
.av .av-eye:last-of-type{animation-delay:.12s}
.av .av-talk{opacity:0}
.av .av-ant{animation:antglow 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
.ringbox.on .av .av-talk,.speaking .av-talk{opacity:1;animation:talkmouth .42s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.ringbox.on .av .av-mouth,.speaking .av-mouth{opacity:0}
.ringbox.on .av .av-eye{animation-duration:2.6s}
@keyframes antglow{0%,100%{opacity:.65}50%{opacity:1}}
@keyframes talkmouth{from{transform:scaleY(.4)}to{transform:scaleY(1)}}
.av .av-talk{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}

/* ---- entrance animations (restrained, timing preserved) ---- */
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes riseL{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-30px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes riseR{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(30px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes pop{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.86)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}}
@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
.anim-rise{animation:rise .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both}
.anim-riseL{animation:riseL .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both}
.anim-riseR{animation:riseR .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both}
.anim-pop{animation:pop .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1.4) both}
.anim-fade{animation:fade .8s ease both}
.d1{animation-delay:.07s}.d2{animation-delay:.15s}.d3{animation-delay:.23s}
.d4{animation-delay:.31s}.d5{animation-delay:.39s}.d6{animation-delay:.47s}
.d7{animation-delay:.55s}.d8{animation-delay:.63s}.d9{animation-delay:.71s}
.d10{animation-delay:.79s}.d11{animation-delay:.87s}.d12{animation-delay:.95s}

/* ---- looping motion (names locked; bodies de-glowed) ---- */
@keyframes floaty{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-12px)}}
@keyframes pulseGlow{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.55}}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes wave{0%,100%{transform:scaleY(.25)}50%{transform:scaleY(1)}}
@keyframes blink{0%,92%,100%{transform:scaleY(1)}96%{transform:scaleY(.08)}}
@keyframes ripple{from{opacity:.5;transform:scale(.9)}to{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.9)}}
@keyframes dash{to{stroke-dashoffset:-16}}
.anim-floaty{animation:floaty 5s ease-in-out infinite}
.anim-pulse{animation:pulseGlow 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}

<body>
<div class="slide slide--soft">
  <div class="relative z-10 h-full flex" style="padding:40px 56px;gap:34px">
    <!-- LEFT 62% : phone mockup -->
    <div class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center" style="flex:1.6;min-width:0">
      <div class="phone anim-rise d1">
        <div class="screen">
          <div class="notch" data-decor aria-hidden="true"></div>
          <div class="phead">

            <div class="pname">Bright Smile Dental · Voice Agent</div>
            <div class="pstatus"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>online</div>
          </div>
          <div class="tabs">
            <button class="tabbtn active" data-tab="chat"><span class="material-icons" aria-hidden="true">chat</span>Chat</button>
            <button class="tabbtn" data-tab="book"><span class="material-icons" aria-hidden="true">event_available</span>Book</button>
            <button class="tabbtn" data-tab="dash"><span class="material-icons" aria-hidden="true">dashboard</span>Dashboard</button>
          </div>

          <!-- CHAT TAB -->
          <div class="pane" id="pane-chat">
            <div class="thread" id="thread">
              <div class="brow2 brow2-a anim-pop"><div class="bub2 bub2-a">Hi! You're through to Bright Smile Dental — how can I help?</div><div class="mini2-a" aria-hidden="true"></div></div>
            </div>
            <div class="qchips" id="qchips">
              <button class="qchip">Book an appointment</button>
              <button class="qchip">Opening hours</button>
              <button class="qchip">Price for a cleaning?</button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- BOOK TAB -->
          <div class="pane hidden" id="pane-book">
            <div id="bookFlow" class="flex flex-col" style="flex:1;min-height:0">
              <div class="dayrow" id="dayRow"></div>
              <div id="slotWrap">
                <div class="pickhint" id="pickHint">Pick a day to see tomorrow's free times</div>
                <div class="slotgrid hidden" id="slotGrid"></div>
              </div>
              <div id="sumWrap" class="hidden"></div>
            </div>
            <div id="bookDone" class="okwrap hidden">
              <div class="okring anim-pop"><span class="material-icons" aria-hidden="true">check</span></div>
              <div class="oktitle anim-pop d2">Booked!</div>
              <div class="okchips">
                <div class="okchip anim-rise d3"><span class="material-icons" style="color:var(--icon)" aria-hidden="true">event</span>Calendar invite sent</div>
                <div class="okchip anim-rise d4"><span class="material-icons" style="color:var(--icon)" aria-hidden="true">mail</span>Email confirmation sent</div>
                <div class="okchip anim-rise d5"><span class="material-icons" style="color:var(--icon)" aria-hidden="true">table_chart</span>Sheet row updated</div>
              </div>
              <button class="reset" id="resetBook">Reset</button>

          </div>

          <!-- DASHBOARD TAB -->
          <div class="pane hidden" id="pane-dash">
            <div class="dashscroll">
              <div class="tiles">

              </div>
              <div class="chartcard">

                <div class="callrow"><span>Robert J.</span><span class="ochip oc-good">booked ✓</span></div>
                <div class="callrow"><span>Walk-in Qs</span><span class="ochip oc-cyan">FAQ ✓</span></div>

      <div class="anim-fade d5" style="font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin:26px 0 10px;font-family:var(--font-num)">What you just touched → what runs it</div>

<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
var $=function(id){return document.getElementById(id);};

/* ---- tabs ---- */
var tabBtns=document.querySelectorAll(".tabbtn");
tabBtns.forEach(function(b){
  b.addEventListener("click",function(){
    tabBtns.forEach(function(x){x.classList.toggle("active",x===b);});
    ["chat","book","dash"].forEach(function(k){
      $("pane-"+k).classList.toggle("hidden",k!==b.dataset.tab);
    });
  });
});

/* ---- chat: quick replies ---- */
var thread=$("thread");
var replies=[
  {q:"Book an appointment",a:"Sure — what day works for you? I have openings tomorrow at 10:00 or 15:30."},
  {q:"Opening hours",a:"We are open Mon–Fri 9:00–18:00, Sat 10:00–14:00."},
  {q:"Price for a cleaning?",a:"A full checkup & cleaning is $80 — want me to book you in?"}
];
function scrollThread(){try{thread.scrollTo({top:thread.scrollHeight,behavior:"smooth"});}catch(e){thread.scrollTop=thread.scrollHeight;}}
function addUser(txt){
  var row=document.createElement("div");row.className="brow2 anim-pop";
  var b=document.createElement("div");b.className="bub2 bub2-c";b.textContent=txt;
  var d=document.createElement("div");d.className="mini2-c";
  row.appendChild(d);row.appendChild(b);
  thread.appendChild(row);scrollThread();
}
function addAgent(txt){
  var row=document.createElement("div");row.className="brow2 brow2-a anim-pop";
  var b=document.createElement("div");b.className="bub2 bub2-a";b.textContent=txt;
  var d=document.createElement("div");d.className="mini2-a";
  row.appendChild(b);row.appendChild(d);
  thread.appendChild(row);scrollThread();
}
function typingOn(){
  var row=document.createElement("div");row.className="brow2 brow2-a";row.id="typingRow";
  var t=document.createElement("div");t.className="bub2 bub2-a typing";
  t.innerHTML="<span></span><span></span><span></span>";
  row.appendChild(t);thread.appendChild(row);scrollThread();
}
document.querySelectorAll("#qchips .qchip").forEach(function(chip,i){
  var r=replies[i];
  if(!r)return;
  chip.addEventListener("click",function(){
    addUser(r.q);typingOn();
    setTimeout(function(){
      var tr=$("typingRow");if(tr)tr.remove();
      addAgent(r.a);
    },700);
  });
});

/* ---- book: day → slot → confirm ---- */
var days=["Mon 16","Tue 17","Wed 18","Thu 19","Fri 20"];
var slots=["09:00","09:30","10:00","11:30","14:00","15:30"];
var selDay=-1,selSlot=-1;
var dayRow=$("dayRow"),slotGrid=$("slotGrid"),pickHint=$("pickHint"),sumWrap=$("sumWrap");
var bookFlow=$("bookFlow"),bookDone=$("bookDone");
var dayBtns=[];

days.forEach(function(d,i){
  var p=document.createElement("button");p.className="daypill";
  p.innerHTML='<span class="d">'+d.slice(0,3)+'</span><span class="n">'+d.slice(4)+'</span>';
  p.addEventListener("click",function(){selectDay(i);});
  dayRow.appendChild(p);dayBtns.push(p);
});
function selectDay(i){
  selDay=i;selSlot=-1;
  dayBtns.forEach(function(p,j){p.classList.toggle("sel",j===i);});
  pickHint.classList.add("hidden");
  slotGrid.innerHTML="";
  slots.forEach(function(s,k){
    var b=document.createElement("button");b.className="slot anim-pop";b.textContent=s;
    b.style.animationDelay=(k*0.06)+"s";
    b.addEventListener("click",function(){selectSlot(k);});
    slotGrid.appendChild(b);
  });
  slotGrid.classList.remove("hidden");
  sumWrap.classList.add("hidden");sumWrap.innerHTML="";
}
function selectSlot(k){
  selSlot=k;
  var btns=slotGrid.querySelectorAll(".slot");
  btns.forEach(function(b,j){b.classList.toggle("sel",j===k);});
  sumWrap.innerHTML="";
  var card=document.createElement("div");card.className="sumcard anim-pop";
  var row=document.createElement("div");row.className="sumrow";
  row.innerHTML='<span class="material-icons" aria-hidden="true">person</span><span>Robert J. · '+days[selDay]+' at '+slots[selSlot]+'</span>';
  var btn=document.createElement("button");btn.className="confirm";btn.textContent="Confirm";
  btn.addEventListener("click",confirmBook);
  card.appendChild(row);card.appendChild(btn);
  sumWrap.appendChild(card);
  sumWrap.classList.remove("hidden");
}
function confirmBook(){
  bookFlow.classList.add("hidden");
  bookDone.classList.remove("hidden");
}
function resetBook(){
  selDay=-1;selSlot=-1;
  dayBtns.forEach(function(p){p.classList.remove("sel");});
  slotGrid.classList.add("hidden");slotGrid.innerHTML="";
  pickHint.classList.remove("hidden");
  sumWrap.classList.add("hidden");sumWrap.innerHTML="";
  bookDone.classList.add("hidden");
  bookFlow.classList.remove("hidden");
}
$("resetBook").addEventListener("click",resetBook);
})();
</script>

  --bg:#ffffff; --bg-2:#f5f7fa; --bg-3:#f3f3f3;
  /* ---- brand (PlayStation blue is precious) ---- */
  --primary:#0070d1;            /* fills, borders, dots, CTA pills */
  --primary-pressed:#0064b7;
  --primary-active:#004d8d;
  --primary-ink:#0070d1;        /* blue TEXT/icons — flips per canvas */
  --accent:#0064b7;             /* secondary step (was violet) */
  --accent-2:#0064b7;
  --warm:#1f2024;               /* Robert = charcoal ink identity */
  --warm-2:#121314;
  --icon:#1f2024;               /* neutral icon chrome */
  /* ---- semantics (token-pure: blue=success, DS warning) ---- */
  --good:#0070d1; --warn:#c81b3a; --bad:#c81b3a;
  /* ---- ink ---- */
  --text:#121314; --muted:rgba(0,0,0,.6); --faint:#6b6b6b;
  /* ---- lines & depth (flat world — no shadows) ---- */
  --line:rgba(0,0,0,.08); --line-soft:rgba(0,0,0,.06);
  --grad:#0070d1;               /* SOLID blue — legacy gradient call sites degrade safely */
  --grad-gold:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffce21 0%,#f5a623 55%,#ee8e00 100%); /* ONE use deck-wide (S12) */
  --shadow-card:none; --shadow-pop:none;
  /* ---- typography ---- */
  --font-heading:'Roboto',sans-serif;
  --font-body:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --font-num:'Inter',sans-serif;
  --fs-display:54px; --fs-h1:44px; --fs-h2:28px; --fs-h3:22px;
  --fs-body:16px; --fs-small:14px; --fs-micro:12px;
}

*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{background:var(--bg)}

/* ---- canvas scoping (the band change IS the divider) ---- */
.slide--soft{--bg:#f3f3f3; --bg-2:#ffffff}
.slide--dark{--bg:#000000; --bg-2:#181818; --bg-3:#121314;
  --text:#ffffff; --muted:rgba(255,255,255,.7); --faint:#cccccc;
  --line:rgba(229,229,229,.2); --line-soft:rgba(229,229,229,.12);
  --primary-ink:#53b1ff; --icon:#cccccc; --good:#53b1ff; --accent-2:#53b1ff}
.slide--blue{--bg:#0070d1; --bg-2:rgba(255,255,255,.10); --bg-3:rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  --text:#ffffff; --muted:rgba(255,255,255,.85); --faint:#dbeafd;
  --line:rgba(255,255,255,.28); --line-soft:rgba(255,255,255,.16);
  --primary:#ffffff; --primary-ink:#ffffff; --icon:#ffffff; --accent:#ffffff; --accent-2:#ffffff; --grad:#ffffff}

::selection{background:rgba(0,112,209,.22);color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary-ink);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:4px}
button{font-family:inherit}
[hidden]{display:none!important}

/* ---- slide canvas: flat, band-colored, zero atmosphere ---- */
.slide{
  width:1280px;height:720px;overflow:hidden;overflow:clip;position:relative;
  background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);
  font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:var(--fs-body);line-height:1.5;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;
}

/* ---- legacy decor: retired (markup deleted in sweep; this is the net) ---- */
.orb{display:none!important}

/* ---- surfaces: 8px radius, hairline, lift = surface contrast ---- */
.card{background:var(--bg-2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px}
.card-lift{background:#ffffff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;box-shadow:none}
.slide--dark .card-lift{background:#181818;border-color:rgba(229,229,229,.2)}
.slide--soft .card-lift{background:#ffffff}
.slide--blue .card-lift{background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.28)}
.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:9999px;padding:5px 14px;color:var(--faint);background:transparent;
  font-size:12px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.1px}
.kicker{letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--faint);
  font-size:12px;font-weight:500;font-family:var(--font-body)}
/* emphasis = the single blue phrase; no gradient text, ever */
.grad-text{color:var(--primary-ink);background:none;-webkit-background-clip:initial;background-clip:initial;-webkit-text-fill-color:currentColor}
.grad-vio{color:var(--primary-ink)}
.num{font-family:var(--font-num);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.divider{height:1px;background:var(--line)}

/* ---- icon badge: neutral chrome — blue lives elsewhere ---- */
.ib{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:8px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;
  background:var(--bg-3);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.ib .material-icons{font-size:22px;color:var(--icon)}

/* ---- SVG avatars (Layla the agent · Robert the caller) — flat vector ---- */
.av{display:block}
.av .av-eye{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;animation:blink 4.8s ease-in-out infinite}
.av .av-eye:last-of-type{animation-delay:.12s}
.av .av-talk{opacity:0}
.av .av-ant{animation:antglow 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
.ringbox.on .av .av-talk,.speaking .av-talk{opacity:1;animation:talkmouth .42s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.ringbox.on .av .av-mouth,.speaking .av-mouth{opacity:0}
.ringbox.on .av .av-eye{animation-duration:2.6s}
@keyframes antglow{0%,100%{opacity:.65}50%{opacity:1}}
@keyframes talkmouth{from{transform:scaleY(.4)}to{transform:scaleY(1)}}
.av .av-talk{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}

/* ---- entrance animations (restrained, timing preserved) ---- */
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes riseL{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-30px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes riseR{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(30px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes pop{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.86)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}}
@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
.anim-rise{animation:rise .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both}
.anim-riseL{animation:riseL .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both}
.anim-riseR{animation:riseR .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both}
.anim-pop{animation:pop .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1.4) both}
.anim-fade{animation:fade .8s ease both}
.d1{animation-delay:.07s}.d2{animation-delay:.15s}.d3{animation-delay:.23s}
.d4{animation-delay:.31s}.d5{animation-delay:.39s}.d6{animation-delay:.47s}
.d7{animation-delay:.55s}.d8{animation-delay:.63s}.d9{animation-delay:.71s}
.d10{animation-delay:.79s}.d11{animation-delay:.87s}.d12{animation-delay:.95s}

/* ---- looping motion (names locked; bodies de-glowed) ---- */
@keyframes floaty{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-12px)}}
@keyframes pulseGlow{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.55}}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes wave{0%,100%{transform:scaleY(.25)}50%{transform:scaleY(1)}}
@keyframes blink{0%,92%,100%{transform:scaleY(1)}96%{transform:scaleY(.08)}}
@keyframes ripple{from{opacity:.5;transform:scale(.9)}to{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.9)}}
@keyframes dash{to{stroke-dashoffset:-16}}
.anim-floaty{animation:floaty 5s ease-in-out infinite}
.anim-pulse{animation:pulseGlow 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
